Basic and diluted earnings per share were $0.34 and $0.33, respectively, for the three months ended December 31, 2024 compared to $0.26 for basic and diluted earnings per share for the three months ended December 31, 2023. The Company also announced that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.06 per share, which will be paid on February 20, 2025 to stockholders of record as of February 6, 2025.
